findings.requirement: Internal corner radii can be made by standard cutters
findings.comment: The specified internal corner radii of R 0.3 mm (D4) and R 0.2 mm (D14) are smaller than the minimum radius achievable by standard end mills or tooling, which typically require a minimum of R 0.5 mm to R 1.0 mm depending on tool availability. This will require special non-standard cutters or EDM processes, increasing cost and lead time; the designer should increase these radii to at least R 0.5 mm or specify a suitable manufacturing process.
findings.recommended_correction: Increase internal corner radii to >= R 0.5 mm.
